> [!WARNING]
> **Do not use this template for non-security issues.** For bugs and feature
> requests, use the [Bug report](?template=bug.md) or [Feature request](?template=feature.md) templates.
>
> Security vulnerabilities must be reported **privately**. See
> [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the private reporting channels.

## Report a security vulnerability privately

Please send a detailed report to
[moreno.bruschi@live.it](mailto:moreno.bruschi@live.it) or use GitHub Private
Vulnerability Reporting.
